title: Fundamental Logic Through the Lens of Modality
summary: Fundamental logic is a non-classical logic based only on the introduction and elimination rules for conjunction, disjunction, negation, and the quantifiers in a Fitch-style natural deduction system. In this paper, we attempt to obtain a better understanding of fundamental logic and its semantics through the lens of modality.
